test_title: PYST 4: Selection Post (Matric Level) - GA (Held On 28 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What is the name of the development bank established by BRICS countries?
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Development Bank**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **New Development Bank (NDB)** is a multilateral development bank established by the **BRICS** states, which include **Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa**. While it was often referred to as the **BRICS Development Bank** during its initial negotiation phase, the official name adopted is the **New Development Bank**.
 
• The agreement for the establishment of the **NDB** was signed during the **6th BRICS Summit** held in **Fortaleza, Brazil**, in **July 2014**. The bank officially began its operations in **July 2015**.
 
• The primary objective of the bank is to mobilize resources for **infrastructure** and **sustainable development** projects in **BRICS** and other **emerging economies** and **developing countries**. This serves as an alternative to the traditional **Bretton Woods** institutions like the **World Bank** and the **International Monetary Fund (IMF)**.
 
• The **NDB** was founded with an **initial authorized capital** of **100 billion US Dollars**. The **initial subscribed capital** was **50 billion US Dollars**, which was divided equally among the five founding members, ensuring that no single country has a veto or dominant share, unlike other global financial institutions.
 
• The bank focuses on several key areas for financing, including **clean energy**, **transport infrastructure**, **irrigation**, **sustainable urban development**, and **economic cooperation** among member nations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Headquarters and Leadership:** The **New Development Bank** is headquartered in **Shanghai, China**. The first President of the bank was **K. V. Kamath** from **India**, who served a five-year term starting in **2015**. As of **2023**, the President of the **NDB** is **Dilma Rousseff**, the former President of **Brazil**.
 
• **Membership Expansion:** In **2021**, the **NDB** initiated a membership expansion drive. It admitted the **United Arab Emirates (UAE)**, **Uruguay**, **Bangladesh**, and **Egypt** as new members. This expansion is intended to strengthen the bank's role as a global development partner for **emerging markets**.
 
• **Contingent Reserve Arrangement (CRA):** Alongside the **NDB**, the **BRICS** nations established the **Contingent Reserve Arrangement** in **2014**. The **CRA** acts as a framework for providing protection against global **liquidity pressures**, including **currency crises**, and helps maintain **financial stability** among member nations.
 
• **Regional Offices:** To facilitate better project management and coordination, the **NDB** has opened several regional offices, including the **Africa Regional Center** in **Johannesburg, South Africa**, the **Americas Regional Office** in **Sao Paulo, Brazil**, and the **Eurasian Regional Center** in **Moscow, Russia**.
 
• **Credit Ratings:** The **NDB** has consistently maintained high **credit ratings** (such as AA+ from S&P Global Ratings), which allows it to borrow funds from international **capital markets** at favorable rates and pass those benefits on to its borrowing member countries.
